indicators.name: Database Dump Utility Execution
indicators.pattern:
title: Database Dump Utility Execution
id: 2b9c1f8a-5e3d-4f6b-8c1a-9d2e0f3b7a4c
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of common database dump utilities (sqlcmd, mysqldump, pg_dump). This activity on a production database server outside of a maintenance window could indicate an attempt to exfiltrate the database, as suggested in the hunting hints for large-scale PII breaches.
references:
  - https://www.giaspace.com/blog/your-july-2026-data-breach-roundup/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-31
tags:
  - attack.t1213.006
  - attack.collection
level: medium
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate database backup or maintenance operations.
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\sqlcmd.exe'
      - '\mysqldump.exe'
      - '\pg_dump.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of database dump utilities such as sqlcmd, mysqldump, or pg_dump. This is based on hunting hints provided in the article for detecting potential large-scale data exfiltration from database servers.
